opening.argument: The speaker warns that influencers are misleading the industry and portrays Avalanche subnets as a possible scheme to induce large players to buy AVAX. He also alleges that the narrative around institutional activity is manipulated. Those are critiques of crypto promotion and market conduct, not instructions to buy an asset, transfer money, or provide sensitive data. The description separately offers channel memberships with stated prices and perks, but the supplied material does not establish that the offer is deceptive. The channel also says it does not advise viewers to buy, sell, trade, or hold digital assets.
